pages.title: Virtuoso: Virtual Piano
pages.creator: Bouraoui Game
pages.description: Perform classical melodies in Virtuoso: Virtual Piano. Hit the falling notes as they reach the bottom line, using mouse input or the corresponding keyboard keys. Five difficulty settings let you work from simpler arrangements toward more demanding performances and song unlocks.

pages.title: Duel
pages.creator: boooogiegames
pages.description: Win short pistol encounters in Duel. Tap to fire and use the characters' physics-driven movement to avoid incoming bullets. Hit the opposing gunfighter first to clear the level and move on to another shooting confrontation.

pages.title: Space Craft: Ship War
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Build an armed spacecraft while exploring in Space Craft: Ship War. Collect decks, weapons, boosters, and rare upgrades to expand the ship into a larger fighting platform. Enemy vessels grow too, making continued collection and combat part of surviving each encounter.

pages.title: Fish Love Pins
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Bring two separated fish together in Fish Love Pins. Remove pins in a carefully chosen order to change the water's route and open a passage between them. Each physics puzzle asks you to consider what will move before pulling the next barrier.

pages.title: Rough Ball
pages.creator: SecGame
pages.description: Bounce a purple character between platforms in Rough Ball. Click on either side of the screen to jump that way while avoiding spikes, skulls, and falls. Collect coins and unlock alternative appearances as you work through the levels.

pages.title: BBQ Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: HeiTie
pages.description: Organize food into matching trios in BBQ Sort Puzzle. Place three identical items on one grill to cook them, uncovering further ingredients as shelves empty. Watch for customer orders and complete those requests while managing the remaining food.

pages.title: Sprunki Link
pages.creator: AF
pages.description: Link identical character tiles in Sprunki Link. Search each board for matching Sprunki faces and connect pairs to remove them. Fifteen levels offer a total of forty-five stars to collect as you work through the tile puzzles.

pages.title: Crazy Fruit Merge
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Create larger fruit in Crazy Fruit Merge by placing identical pieces together on the board. Bigger fruit takes up more space, complicating later placements. Use the two available power-ups to help preserve room while you aim for a higher score.

pages.title: Mr Cappuccino Assassino
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Line up shots at hostile characters in Mr Cappuccino Assassino. Work through shooting puzzles that test where and when to aim. Collect stars from the encounters and unlock additional meme-inspired characters as you continue the campaign.

pages.title: Geometry Dash Maze Maps V2
pages.creator: atupdev
pages.description: Keep a fast-moving square alive in Geometry Dash Maze Maps V2. Tap to jump over spikes and onto platforms while it automatically advances through the maze. Six levels test how accurately you respond to the obstacles appearing along the route.

pages.title: Archer Go
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Take bow shots through an ongoing journey in Archer Go. Tap, hold, and release to send arrows at targets and earn points. Unlock appearance options for both the archer and the targets while continuing to work on accurate hits.

pages.title: Toy Claw Simulator
pages.creator: vetx
pages.description: Operate a prize crane in Toy Claw Simulator. Move it above a collectible, then lower the claw to attempt a grab. Sell gathered toys at the factory for coins, using the proceeds to run the machine and discover additional prizes.

pages.title: Obby On a Bike
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Ride through elevated obstacle courses in Obby On a Bike. Take your time in Normal mode or race the clock in Challenge mode. Play alone or compete with a second rider while using jumps and careful steering to cross the platforms.

pages.title: Idle Egg Farmer
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Build a producing farm in Idle Egg Farmer. Click an egg to hatch an animal, then let its ongoing egg production supply delivery trucks. Sell the output and upgrade the farm so a larger collection of animals can generate more income.

pages.title: Fight to the end
pages.creator: yiyuan
pages.description: Keep an assault soldier alive in Fight to the end. Move away from incoming attacks and fight through the enemy crowd. Each level increase offers three random buffs, letting you choose between strengthening skills and improving the character's attributes.

pages.title: Stickman Choosing actions
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Choose an escape plan in Stickman Choosing actions. Inspect the two offered items or actions and select the one that lets the captive continue. Each decision changes whether the stick figure can progress beyond the creature's prison.

pages.title: Blossom
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Connect neighboring flower buds in Blossom. A chain of at least three matching buds opens into flowers and adds to your score. More flower types and a faster timer complicate the board as you try to improve your best result.

pages.title: Bowling Stars
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Compete in lane matches in Bowling Stars. Swipe to set the ball's path and curve, then aim for a stronger score than the opponent. Earn trophies to unlock better bowling balls and take on increasingly capable rivals.

pages.title: Tail Gun Charlie
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Complete aerial combat missions in Tail Gun Charlie. Control the aircraft and attack enemy planes while working through the assigned encounters. The game centers on handling the flight and shooting opposition out of the sky.

pages.title: Clean The Floor
pages.creator: Rocket Studio
pages.description: Remove dirt from a neglected house in Clean The Floor. Move the cleaner near stained areas so the vacuum can begin working. Upgrade its power to tackle tougher messes and continue until the floor meets the owner's expectations.

pages.title: Streamer Rush
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Change a character's appearance during a run in Streamer Rush. Swipe left and right to guide her along the route and explore different clothing styles. The game combines runner movement with building new looks for the character.

pages.title: Farm Match Seasons
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Care for a farm through matching puzzles in Farm Match Seasons. Swap crops, fruit, and flowers into groups of at least three to meet tasks such as harvesting and protecting butterflies. Larger combinations create extra rewards and boosters for harder layouts.

pages.title: Workshop Tools Link
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Pair identical equipment tiles in Workshop Tools Link. The line joining a pair can turn no more than twice, so clear routes determine which tools are available. Empty the board before the timer expires to finish the puzzle.

pages.title: Solitaire Daily Challenge
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Build suit foundations in Solitaire Daily Challenge. Move cards toward stacks running from ace through king and work to clear the layout. A fresh shuffled challenge is offered each day, giving you another arrangement to solve and score.

pages.title: Formula Rush
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Compete against a crowded field of race cars in Formula Rush. Accelerate on clear stretches and slow down for bends to stay on the track. Going onto the grass reduces speed sharply, allowing rivals to pull away.

pages.title: Mechanic Master Run
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Collect vehicle parts during a run in Mechanic Master Run. Slide along the course and choose components matching the displayed target. Bring the required pieces to the end while keeping your collection aligned with the requested build.

pages.title: Kimono Fashion
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Give a princess a Japanese-inspired makeover in Kimono Fashion. Start by decorating her room, then choose makeup before selecting a kimono. Coordinate traditional clothing with the available modern styling choices to complete Milana's finished look.

pages.title: Cat Girl Valentine Story Deep Water
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Help a lonely heroine search for a love potion in Cat Girl Valentine Story Deep Water. Follow her adventure after a friend suggests a way to repair her relationship. Complete the tasks leading toward the potion and the hoped-for reunion.

pages.title: Aquatic Blocks
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Clear matching groups of blocks in Aquatic Blocks. Remove neighboring pieces of the same type until the level is empty. Selecting a single block costs two hundred points, so plan collections that avoid leaving too many isolated tiles.

pages.title: Happy Stars Match 3
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Swap colored stars into rows in Happy Stars Match 3. Form horizontal or vertical groups of at least three and keep clearing them until every underlying tile is removed. Power-ups help complete the thirty-six levels more efficiently.

pages.title: Resize Mahjong
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Match animal pictures across differently sized tiles in Resize Mahjong. Shape and size do not prevent a pair from matching when both show the same animal. Clear the board to free the creatures, using hints or shuffles when needed.

pages.title: Splitty Adventures
pages.creator: Elite Games Ltd
pages.description: Gather sacred flames in Splitty Adventures. Divide the character at the right moments so the smaller pieces travel toward different fire locations. Collect every flame in the stage while working to save the world from hostile pumpkins.

pages.title: Mosaic Artimo
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Build colorful tile pictures in Mosaic Artimo. Select pieces and place them where they belong to complete each mosaic design. The in-game guide helps explain the puzzles as you work through the arrangements and their required colors.

pages.title: Blocks 2
pages.creator: Gibton
pages.description: Clear puzzle layouts in Blocks 2 by moving blocks into matching lines. Choose moves that make pieces disappear and leave no block behind. Sixty levels provide different arrangements that require a workable sequence rather than random repositioning.

pages.title: Royal Guards
pages.creator: Elite Games Ltd
pages.description: Defend a sacred forest as an archer in Royal Guards. Aim at waves of undead and other hostile creatures, using abilities to strengthen your attacks. Earn gold and experience from kills and reinvest them in skills that help repel later enemies.

pages.title: Black Jack Puzzle
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Create card chains totaling twenty-one in Black Jack Puzzle. Compare the available values and connect a combination that reaches the target exactly. The game turns the familiar blackjack total into a series of number-based card puzzles.

pages.title: Two Rows Colors
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Match a vertically moving ball with the correct colored endpoint in Two Rows Colors. Tap to shift the rows at the top and bottom horizontally. Keep aligning a same-colored ball as the central one repeatedly changes its color.

pages.title: Duel of wizards
pages.creator: ArturKarapetyan
pages.description: Win magical confrontations in Duel of wizards. Time your attacks to strike the opposing wizard, using keyboard or on-screen controls during the physics-driven encounters. Additional hats give you ways to change the character's appearance between duels.

pages.title: Craft Punch
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Strike one kind of block-world character and spare the other in Craft Punch. Hit Steve when he appears, but avoid punching the human. Play alone or share the challenge with another player, competing for the higher number of correct hits.

pages.title: Crazy Bunny
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Help a rabbit reach its carrot in Crazy Bunny. Interact with the blocks around the platform course to open a workable route, keeping traps from interrupting the journey. Two modes provide different versions of the colorful puzzle adventure.

pages.title: Baby Animal
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Identify young animals in Baby Animal. Look at the available pictures and click the animal that corresponds to the requested baby form. The activity introduces how different species look during their early stages of life.

pages.title: Penalty Champs 21
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Lead a national team through a shootout in Penalty Champs 21. Set a shot's direction, height, and power when attacking, then respond to the opponent's target cue as goalkeeper. Win both sides of the contest to pursue the championship.

pages.title: Princess New Born Twins Baby Care
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Look after two infants in Princess New Born Twins Baby Care. Bathe them, prepare food, and choose outfits and hairstyles for the day. Work through the care routine to keep both twins attended to throughout their shared activities.

pages.title: Danger Corner
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Time sharp turns in Danger Corner. Tap as the car approaches each bend to keep it following the road. Its speed changes during the drive, so the right moment to turn shifts as you continue around the course.

pages.title: Space Racing 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Pilot a futuristic craft through space-themed races in Space Racing 3D. Move left and right to manage the flight and compete at speed. Upgrade the available aircraft to improve your machine as you continue the racing challenges.

pages.title: Space Alien Invaders
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Protect Earth from descending formations in Space Alien Invaders. Move your ship horizontally, dodge attacks, and fire lasers at aliens and UFOs. Keep the invasion from reaching the ground while building a higher score through the ongoing waves.

pages.title: Road Trip
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Drive across different tracks in Road Trip. Collect money to buy additional cars and choose a vehicle suited to the route ahead. Work through twenty levels while balancing progress along each course with collecting funds for the next car.

pages.title: Laser Maker
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Redirect beams toward their destinations in Laser Maker. Interact with the level's reflecting elements to change each laser's path. Work out an arrangement that brings the light to the goal and completes the puzzle.

pages.title: Lovely Virtual Cat
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Spend time with a digital pet in Lovely Virtual Cat. Feed the cat, take selfies, visit friends, and explore activities around its home. The character's reactions accompany the different parts of its virtual daily routine.

pages.title: Mathematics
pages.creator: KasoiGame
pages.description: Solve displayed arithmetic examples in Mathematics. Choose a level, work out each result, and enter your answer for the game to check. Correct and incorrect feedback lets you assess the calculation before continuing with another problem.

pages.title: Happy Spring Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Rebuild bright seasonal scenes in Happy Spring Jigsaw Puzzle. Choose one of eight pictures and a six-, twelve-, or twenty-four-piece arrangement. Drag the sections into place to complete the spring image before selecting another puzzle.

pages.title: Line Color 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Paint a route by moving forward in Line Color 3D. Guide the line through the white area while keeping clear of obstacles along the road. Reach the end to complete the level and continue to another coloring course.

pages.title: Cartoon Bus Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore illustrated passenger-vehicle scenes in Cartoon Bus Slide. Pick one of three pictures and a puzzle mode, then rearrange the shuffled image sections. Compare the bus and background details to find the completed layout.

pages.title: Pixel Battles
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Compete across four retro contests in Pixel Battles. A spinning selector chooses among football, helicopter combat, tank fighting, and kart racing. The first player to score three wins, with overall results tracked on the main menu.

pages.title: Draw Line
pages.creator: Game-Devs
pages.description: Join matching endpoints in Draw Line. Select one colored point and drag a path toward its partner, repeating the process for the other pairs. The puzzle centers on building the required connections between similarly colored points.

pages.title: Marble Maze
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Fill empty spaces by striking balls in Marble Maze. Swipe to send a ball into another and use the resulting movement to fill the holes. Work out which direction and order of hits will complete the arrangement.

pages.title: Santa Helper
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Gather presents for the holiday in Santa Helper. Control one of Santa's assistants and steer around obstacles while collecting gifts. The objective is to bring in as many presents as possible without letting the hazards interrupt the collection.

pages.title: East Endless Runner Game : Prince Rash Adventure
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Run through a busy route in East Endless Runner Game : Prince Rash Adventure. Jump past vehicles and other obstacles, collect coins, and use a hang glider during the journey. Keep dodging ahead to extend the run and improve your score.

pages.title: Reindeer Match
pages.creator: Black Sheep Games
pages.description: Connect same-colored animals in Reindeer Match. Drag through two or more matching reindeer to score, with longer chains offering better results. Each successful group extends the remaining time, giving you a way to keep the matching session going.

pages.title: Beach Burger
pages.creator: jogosonlineapps.com.br
pages.description: Serve made-to-order sandwiches in Beach Burger. Choose the ingredients needed for each customer's burger and finish before their waiting time runs out. Further burgers unlock as you progress, while too many unhappy customers cause the service attempt to fail.

pages.title: Popstar Girls Dress Up
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Style performers for the stage in Popstar Girls Dress Up. Choose clothing and makeover options to create sparkling pop-star looks. Coordinate the available pieces for each girl and compare combinations before finishing her appearance.

pages.title: Christmas Fantasy Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble holiday scenes in Christmas Fantasy Puzzle. Six images offer four piece counts, from sixteen to one hundred. Choose a difficulty and rebuild the selected picture, using its seasonal details to locate each section's correct place.

pages.title: Hidden Toys
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find requested playthings in Hidden Toys. Follow the item list shown beside the scene and click each object when you locate it. Complete the search before time expires to earn bonus points for the level.

pages.title: Christmas tap tap
pages.creator: Nicolas Tacgorian
pages.description: Fly a holiday sleigh through a city in Christmas tap tap. Touch the screen to push it upward and guide Santa toward the stars. Keep collecting as the rising difficulty makes the route harder to manage.

pages.title: Santa Chimney Challenge
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Guide Santa's sleigh team past rooftops in Santa Chimney Challenge. Use one-touch input to keep the reindeer clear of the chimneys along the way. Try to travel farther without knocking over one of the obstacles.

pages.title: Poly Tennis
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Play short tennis matches in Poly Tennis. Control the action with the mouse and keep returning the ball until you win the exchange. The first competitor to reach three takes the match in its low-polygon sports setting.

pages.title: Crazy Halloween Memory
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Find matching holiday creatures in Crazy Halloween Memory. Reveal pairs of tiles, remember their pictures, and clear all the matches. Four levels challenge you to complete the board with fewer moves by using the information from earlier reveals.

pages.title: Express Truck
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Deliver a load across uneven ground in Express Truck. Drive quickly enough to earn points while keeping the goods aboard through the rough terrain. A successful delivery depends on reaching the destination with the cargo still intact.

pages.title: Fall To Rescue
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Guide a descending bird toward a rescue in Fall To Rescue. Avoid spikes and collect coins while helping the dove reach the other bird. The falling route requires careful movement so the rescue attempt does not end in a collision.

pages.title: Castle Puzzle
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Remove blocks from a structure in Castle Puzzle without bringing the castle down. Consider which pieces are supporting the rest before clicking them away. A careless removal can collapse the arrangement and spoil the attempt.

pages.title: Red Boy Game
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Drive through checkpoint routes in Red Boy Game. Use WASD or the arrow keys to steer the car and follow the course. Track your progress through the checkpoints while handling the vehicle alongside the opposing drivers.

pages.title: Fast Burger
pages.creator: yupiy
pages.description: Prepare food orders in Fast Burger. Work with burger ingredients and manage the kitchen tasks while the order timers run. Keep the cooking organized so the requested meals can be completed before the available preparation time expires.

pages.title: Carley Fun Tattoo
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Color a character's large back design in Carley Fun Tattoo. Help her fill in the tattoo so it is ready to show off. Use the available coloring choices to create the finished version of the illustrated body art.

pages.title: Cut It Down Online
pages.creator: 4j.com
pages.description: Slice geometric pieces in Cut It Down Online. Cut a shape so its falling sections collect the stars required to finish the stage. Plan the cut carefully when trying to gather all three stars rather than just completing the level.

pages.title: COLORUID 2
pages.creator: Roman Parada
pages.description: Turn an entire board into one shade in COLORUID 2. Choose color changes that spread through the layout and bring separate regions together. The puzzle depends on selecting a sequence that unifies every part of the playing field.

pages.title: Moto X3M 4 Winter
pages.creator: MadPuffers
pages.description: Race a motorcycle through frozen stunt tracks in Moto X3M 4 Winter. Avoid traps and explosives, use flips to improve your time, and reach the finish quickly. Earn stars from faster completions and spend them on additional riders.

pages.title: Wham O Slip N Slide
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Slide through a Hawaiian obstacle course in Wham O Slip N Slide. Switch lanes, jump, and duck past cars and roadblocks while collecting coins and coconuts. Spend earnings on unusual equipment such as floats, hand paddles, and rocket packs.

pages.title: Idle Farm Tycoon
pages.creator: Bubito
pages.description: Grow an animal-based business in Idle Farm Tycoon. Build income around chickens and cows through its farming clicker activities. Keep developing the farm's production as you work toward turning the small operation into a richer agricultural enterprise.

pages.title: Shards
pages.creator: SBC Games
pages.description: Bounce balls off a paddle to break glass tiles in Shards. Clear every brick as quickly as possible, collecting power-ups while avoiding bombs. Eighty layouts vary the scale, rotation, and arrangement of the targets you need to destroy.

pages.title: Space Shooter
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Hold off hostile fleets in Space Shooter. Command a spacecraft through forty levels and destroy approaching aliens before their attacks tear it apart. Keep firing while handling incoming missiles and the enemy formation advancing toward you.

pages.title: 100 Metres Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Compete in a sprint in 100 Metres Game. Use the arrow controls to drive your runner down the track and beat the other athletes' times. Collect medals that improve energy as you work toward a place on the podium.

pages.title: Doodle God: Rocket Scientist
pages.creator: JoyBits
pages.description: Invent new technology in Doodle God: Rocket Scientist. Combine elements to discover machines and scientific advances, from aircraft to space-travel equipment. Each successful invention expands the world's possibilities and supplies further material for more complex discoveries.

pages.title: Flaap.io
pages.creator: FREEGAMES66
pages.description: Compete with other airborne birds in Flaap.io. Keep flapping to maintain flight and try to continue farther alongside friends. Additional unusual bird characters give the multiplayer flying challenge more appearances to discover.

pages.title: Adam and Eve 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Help a prehistoric adventurer leave captivity in Adam and Eve 2. Inspect each scene and click objects to change the situation or open a route onward. Solve the environmental puzzles so Adam can continue his escape and explore new places.

pages.title: Princess Perfect Wedding
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Prepare a royal ceremony in Princess Perfect Wedding. Choose a bridal gown from the available boutiques and help select the wedding venue. Coordinate the main decisions so the princess is ready for her marriage celebration.

pages.title: Princesses Homecoming
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Dress former classmates for a reunion in Princesses Homecoming. Choose outfits for the three friends as they prepare to meet again after graduation. Combine the available fashion pieces into individual looks for their return to college.

pages.title: Modern Princess Perfect Make Up
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Create a complete beauty look in Modern Princess Perfect Make Up. Apply foundation, select eye makeup, and add finishing cosmetic details. Pair the result with a hairstyle, adjusting colors and styling choices as you prepare the princess's makeover.

pages.title: Barbie's Patchwork Peasant Dress
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Design a personalized garment in Barbie's Patchwork Peasant Dress. Begin by choosing the upper section, then develop a dress that fits the character's style. The fashion challenge focuses on combining design choices into a peasant-inspired outfit.

pages.title: Ice Queen Fashion Day H5
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Choose an outfit from a royal wardrobe in Ice Queen Fashion Day H5. Select a dress, then coordinate shoes, a purse, and a hairstyle. Mix the available fashion pieces to give the queen a complete look for the day.
